title: Preserve provider artifact association for session roots with a separate Git directory
outcome: A session whose own worktree uses a plain Git pointer file, such as a submodule or a separately stored Git directory, can associate its original launcher artifact using bounded Git metadata reads and exact original artifact custody.
acceptance: Behavior tests use real session roots whose .git is a file outside the linked-worktree registry, and show the original launcher run associates after provider start.

A replaced, redirected or non-regular Git marker refuses association without following an unapproved directory. Association requires the original runtime, execution and request and grants no independent verification credit.
